description:
Damage areas for Complex emergency, Central African Republic, 12 December 2013 (CE20131212CAF): 32 features merged from 6 source layers. Polygon layers with a damage class column: damaged areas, zones, or density cells. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Geodata of Damage Assesment in Bangui, Central African Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assesment-in-bangui-central-african-republic-july-02-2014)
- [Geodata of Damage Assesment in Bangui, Central African Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assesment-in-bangui-central-african-republic-march-07-2014)
- [Geodata of Damage Assesment in Bouar, Nana Membere Province, Central African republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assesment-in-bouar-nana-membere-province-central-african-re-march-14-2014)
- [Geodata of Damage Assessment in Marcounda Sub-Prefecture, Central African Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assessment-in-marcounda-sub-prefecture-central-african-repu-july-08-2014)
- [Geodata of Damage Assessment in Paoua, OuhamPende, Central African Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assessment-in-paoua-ouhampende-central-african-republic-june-23-2014)
- [Geodata of Destruction in Bossangoa Area, Ouham, Central African Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-destruction-in-bossangoa-area-ouham-central-african-republic-march-14-2014)
- [Geodata of IDP Settlement, M Poko Airport, Bangui, Central African Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-idp-settlement-m-poko-airport-bangui-central-african-republic-january-24-2014)
- [Geodata of IDP Settlement, M'Poko Airport, Bangui, Central African Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-idp-settlement-mpoko-airport-bangui-central-african-republic-june-26-2014)
- [Geodata of IDP Settlement, M'Poko Airport, Bangui, Central African Republic](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-idp-settlement-mpoko-airport-bangui-central-african-republic-october-21-2015)
- [Geodata of Sido Refugee Camp, Moyen - Chari Region, Republic of Chad](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-sido-refugee-camp-moyen-chari-region-republic-of-chad-june-03-2014)
- [Geodata of Sido Refugee Camp, Moyen - Chari Region, Republic of Chad](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-sido-refugee-camp-moyen-chari-region-republic-of-chad-june-19-2014)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SiteID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetary; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Staduim; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site. The decoded text is in `SiteID_label`.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Worldview-1; 2 = Worldview-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = Komsat-2; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 999 = Combination of Sensors. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `ConfidenceID_label`.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `FieldValidation_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Main_Damage_Site_Class
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Destroyed; 2 = Severe Damage; 3 = Moderate Damage; 4 = Possible Damage; 5 = Impact Crater (Damage to Road); 6 = No Visible Damage; 7 = Impact Crater (Damage to Field); 8 = Destroyed (Demolition Zone); 9 = Suspected Phosphorus shell Attack Zone; 10 = Road Damage from Tank Passage; 11 = Possible Damage from adjacent impact, debris. The decoded text is in `Main_Damage_Site_Class_label`.

table:columns.name: Grouped_Damage_Classes
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Damaged Buildings; 2 = Damaged Greenhouses; 3 = Impacts on Roads / Bridges; 4 = Impacts in Fields; 5 = Damaged Road segments. The decoded text is in `Grouped_Damage_Classes_label`.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 2 source files of this collection use 2 different domains for it, so read `StaffID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Shape_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Shape_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID_label
table:columns.description: `ConfidenceID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation_label
table:columns.description: `FieldValidation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Grouped_Damage_Classes_label
table:columns.description: `Grouped_Damage_Classes` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Main_Damage_Site_Class_label
table:columns.description: `Main_Damage_Site_Class` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SiteID_label
table:columns.description: `SiteID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
